lifecycleCoverage.limitation: A setup that never qualifies inside the protected setup engine emits no event at all -- the engine only surfaces setups that already qualified.

lifecycleCoverage.provenance: Every newly opened trade now carries strategyProvenance (Phase 5).

TRADE_CLOSED is defined in the schema but not emitted for ALEX; alexGCloseLivePosition is PROTECTED.

note: MOGO-002.5 Phase 6 REUSES the existing Decision Event architecture rather than introducing a parallel trace. This file records which fidelity rule each existing RULE_EVALUATED ruleId corresponds to, and states honestly which lifecycle stages are already traced and which are structurally unreachable.

structuralLimitations.detail: alexGEvaluateBreakRetest and alexGEvaluateRepeatedReaction are PROTECTED and their {qualifies:false} return contract discards WHICH condition failed. Per-condition rule tracing for ALEX_SR_005 and ALEX_SR_011 is therefore unreachable without either a protected-function edit or reimplementing their logic externally -- both forbidden.

Decision events are memory-only (DECISION_EVENT_MAX_LOG_SIZE=500, zero localStorage keys). Traces do not survive a page reload, so a fidelity report cannot be built from historical traces today -- only from live observation.
